text:
iris: bringing up the new L2-derivative on staging, hit a weird tokenization drift vs upstream evals. locally the HF checkpoint tokenizes differently than what our conversion produced. suspect mismatch between tokenizer.json and tokenizer_config.json; slow python tokenizer ended up being used in the conversion path.

sanjay: can you paste the file list from the artifact? copy/paste `ls -la` of the model dir would help.

iris: sure, here's the artifact: 
```
-rw-r--r-- 1 runner runner  262k Mar  4 08:12 config.json
-rw-r--r-- 1 runner runner 1.2M Mar  4 08:12 pytorch_model.bin
-rw-r--r-- 1 runner runner  512k Mar  4 08:12 tokenizer.json
-rw-r--r-- 1 runner runner  1.1k Mar  4 08:12 tokenizer_config.json
-rw-r--r-- 1 runner runner   12k Mar  4 08:12 vocab.json
-rw-r--r-- 1 runner runner   20k Mar  4 08:12 merges.txt
```
There's no added_tokens.json and tokenizer.json seems to be the fast format, but the running convert step logged a fallback to slow when applying special tokens.

mike: what does the special token map look like from transformers? run: `python -c "from transformers import AutoTokenizer; t=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('PATH'); print(t.special_tokens_map)"`

iris: output was: `{'bos_token': '<s>', 'eos_token': '</s>'}` from the python tokenizer. But the tokenizer.json (fast) inside has no explicit `special_tokens_map` entry and `vocab.json` + `merges.txt` suggest a different unk/pad behavior. Also tokenizer_config.json includes `pad_token: '<pad>'` and `add_prefix_space: true` which affects tokenization of leading spaces.

tokenizer-bot: conversion log excerpt: 
```
INFO: Using tokenizer.json (fast) for base tokenization
WARN: Missing added_tokens.json - special tokens inferred from tokenizer_config.json
INFO: Falling back to slow tokenizer to honor tokenizer_config.json.pad_token
```

sanjay: aha — fallback to slow tokenizer because `pad_token` was absent from the fast json. That explains subtle differences in token boundaries for prompts with leading spaces. Our evals are sensitive to a couple tokens and quantization magnifies it.

mike: quick fixes: either (A) synthesize `added_tokens.json` and merge specials into tokenizer.json before conversion, or (B) run the convert tool with `--prefer-fast` and a post-patch that injects `pad_token` into the fast mapping. Prefer A since it's reproducible and matches HF intent.

iris: I tried injecting pad token into tokenizer.json manually (added `special_tokens_map` and `added_tokens` entries) and re-ran the local convert. unit-token checks now match `python` tokenizer for a set of prompt seeds. patch: 
```
# pseudo-patch applied to tokenizer.json (merged in the top-level mapping)
"special_tokens_map": {"pad_token": "<pad>", "bos_token": "<s>", "eos_token": "</s>"},
"added_tokens": [{"id":50256,"content":"<pad>"}]
```
re-ran the small eval set: rouge/bleu-ish metric aligned, no regression.

sanjay: nice. can you commit the patch to the onboarding repo and kick a staging conversion? also add an automated check to fail conversion when tokenizer_config.json has special tokens not present in tokenizer.json. we've seen this silently break a few bring-ups.

iris: opened PR: https://stash.redwood/infra/tokenizer-onboard/pull/128 (patch + test that runs `AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained` and compares token ids for sample inputs).

deploy-bot: staging conversion kicked for model `redwood/l2-alt-2026` at 1767770200.

mike: long-term: we should update the HF-compat converter to auto-merge `tokenizer_config.json` specials into tokenizer.json when fast format is present but missing specials. add a warning and a flag to opt-out. will create a ticket.

iris: raising ticket RD-INF-514: "converter: merge special tokens from tokenizer_config into tokenizer.json when needed" with repro steps and minimal diff. assigned to mike.

sanjay: also add a small eval in the bring-up checklist: token-level hash for 10 canonical prompts (space variants included). that would've caught the regression earlier.

iris: agreed. PR includes a quick TSV of 10 prompts and expected token sequences. once staging passes we'll promote to dedicated cluster.

tokenizer-bot: staging conversion succeeded at 1767770325; no token drift on smoke set.

iris: thanks all. follow-ups: mike will schedule converter change; sanjay add on-boarding token-hash check; i'll watch the downstream quantization evals. :thumbsup:
